subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets + widget authoring SDK

question: Should maintainers accept this dashboard chart and widget-authoring surface now, and if so should the inherited dashboard dependency graph and sandboxed-widget boundary changes be authorized for this exact head?
rationale: The PR combines a new bundled dashboard surface, dependency graph changes, and an untrusted-widget browser security boundary with a concrete runtime binding bug; automation cannot choose the product and security acceptance path.

options.title: Repair and restack first
options.body: Require the binding-contract fix, a clean stack/base after prerequisite dashboard PRs, dependency-guard resolution, and live chart proof before considering merge.

options.title: Accept the stack risk explicitly
options.body: A maintainer and security owner can authorize the dependency graph and review the cumulative dashboard stack as one exceptional large PR.

options.title: Pause for a narrower follow-up
options.body: Hold this branch until Wave 1 lands, then ask for a small chart/docs-only PR with inherited dependency changes removed.

recommendation.title: Repair and restack first
recommendation.body: Require the binding-contract fix, a clean stack/base after prerequisite dashboard PRs, dependency-guard resolution, and live chart proof before considering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the Control UI plugin-tab product boundary and bundled plugin security posture introduced by the Logbook work.
